submission.justification: Module-D3 at 30% coverage gives the highest simulated light collection, 52.0 PE/MeV. D2 gives 35.3 and D1 gives 27.8 at the same coverage. Feedthroughs are available for up to 30% coverage. WARNING: the hard thermal-cycling requirement (at most 5% failures after 20 cycles) is unverified for every design. No document or simulation covers it. D3 uses a thin bonded dichroic filter, and bonded joints are a plausible cryogenic failure risk. Because modules cannot be replaced once the cryostat is filled, this recommendation is conditional. Before the Q3 design freeze, run thermal-cycle test data on D3. If D3 fails the test, fall back to D2 and then D1, which have not been tested either.

requirements.evidence: D3 at 30% coverage: 51.99 PE/MeV, versus D2 35.3 and D1 27.8.

requirements.requirement: At most 5% module failures after 20 thermal cycles (300 K to 87 K)
requirements.evidence: No thermal-cycling data exists in the documents or the simulation tool. The D3 bonded dichroic filter is a potential risk. This needs testing before the design is frozen.
